اقتضبنا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَضَبْنَا (iqtaḍabnā) /iq.ta.dˤab.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# اُقْتُضِبْنَا (uqtuḍibnā) /uq.tu.dˤib.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
